title: 第932章 那道背影第931章 不祥族群逆天底蕴
lines: 而且，这个数量似乎还在源源不断地增加！
无归界之中，仿佛还有无穷无尽的超脱者，随时都可能踏出。
这才是令诸天万界生灵真正感到绝望的地方！
八对十二，数量上的绝对劣势，让战局从一开始便倾斜向了不祥阵营。
若非诸天万界的八尊超脱者个个身经百战，战斗经验无比丰富，又各有绝学傍身，恐怕防线早已彻底崩溃。
大战，在持续……进入了白热化……
这一战，便是两百多年。
两百多年里，无归时空海从未有过片刻安宁。
超脱者的大战从无归时空海的这一头，打到那一头，又从那一头打回来。
原本就混乱不堪的时空海，被打得愈发支离破碎。
无数的时空节点崩塌，无数的残破世界湮灭。
地面战场的厮杀更是惨烈到了极点。
一批又一批的修士奔赴前线，然后一批又一批地战死。
尸体堆积如山，鲜血汇成了河流，将灰暗的无归时空海，染成了刺目的暗红色。
半步超脱级别的强者，都如同韭菜般一茬茬倒下。
画主战死了！
丹天帝战死了！
尘帝重伤，被宁无咎拼死救回，却也本源大损，再无战力。
叶遮天、叶北辰、玄天帝、神魔仙尊等人先后出关参战，个个浴血搏杀，虽重创了不少敌方半步超脱，却也个个身负重伤，只能退居二线养伤。
北斗七星在最危急的关头破关而出，七人结北斗七星阵，硬生生拖住了两尊不祥超脱者数百回合，为防线争取到了宝贵的喘息时间。
可七人也因此本源重创，潇洒哥断了一臂，任平生剑碎心脉，凰邪涅盘之力几乎耗尽，全员重伤濒死，被神秘生灵拼死救回了后方。
若非八大超脱者拼死抵挡，整个防线早已灰飞烟灭。
可即便如此，局势也在不断恶化。
两百多年过去，无归时空海的防线，就已经彻底崩塌了三道。
诸天万界一方的生灵损失惨重，幸存者十不存一。
饶是那仅存的几尊超脱者——混沌龙主，宁无咎，太上剑帝，星河刀祖，吞天牛主，粪海蛆皇，至尊马皇，白虎女帝，这些超脱者皆是身形染血，各自身上出现了不同程度的伤势。
混沌龙主的龙袍破碎，胸口有一道深可见骨的爪痕，黑色的不祥之力不断侵蚀着伤口，只能以龙气强行压制。
宁无咎的素白长袍沾满了血污，左臂不自然地垂落，显然是被打断了骨头。
太上剑帝的长剑之上布满了裂纹，嘴角不断溢出金色的血液。
白虎女帝的战甲碎裂了大半，发丝凌乱，清冷的脸上也带着几分疲惫。
局势，在朝着不祥族群一方无限倾斜着……
所有人都清楚，照这样下去，败亡只是时间问题。
最多再过百年，不祥大军便能彻底踏平无归时空海，杀入九天十地，将诸天万界彻底拖入黑暗深渊。
绝望的情绪，如同乌云般笼罩在每一个生灵的心头。
很多人都已经做好了死战到底的准备。
content_en:
Moreover, this number seems to be continuously increasing!
In the realm of no return, there seem to be endless transcendent beings who may step out at any time.
This is the place where all the creatures in the world truly feel despair!
Eight versus twelve, the absolute disadvantage in numbers tilted the battle towards the ominous camp from the very beginning.
If it weren't for the eight transcendent beings in all the worlds who have experienced hundreds of battles, have extremely rich combat experience, and each have their own unique skills, I am afraid that the defense line would have completely collapsed.
The war continues... and becomes intense...
This battle lasted more than two hundred years.
For more than two hundred years, there has never been a moment of peace in the time and space of No Return.
The battle between the transcendent beings started from one end of the empty sea of ​​​​no return, to that end, and then back from the other end.
The originally chaotic space-time sea was beaten into even more fragments.
Countless time and space nodes collapsed, and countless broken worlds were annihilated.
The fighting on the ground battlefield was even more brutal.
Group after group of monks rushed to the front line, and then group after group died in battle.
Corpses piled up like mountains, and blood merged into rivers, dyeing the gray sea of ​​time and space into a dazzling dark red.
The strong men who had reached the level of transcendence all fell like leeks.
The painter died in battle!
Emperor Dantian died in battle!
Emperor Chen was seriously injured and was rescued by Ning Wujiu, but his strength was greatly damaged and he no longer had any fighting power.
Ye Zhetian, Ye Beichen, Emperor Xuantian, Divine Demon Immortal Lord and others came out of seclusion to join the battle one after another. They all fought bloody battles. Although many enemies were severely injured and half-stepped away, they were all seriously injured and could only retreat to the second line to recuperate.
The Big Dipper broke through at the most critical moment. The seven people formed the Big Dipper formation and held off the two ominous transcendents for hundreds of rounds, gaining precious breathing time for the defense line.
But the seven people were also seriously injured by this source. Xiaosha broke his arm, Ren Shengsheng's sword broke his heart, Huang Xie's power of Nirvana was almost exhausted, and all of them were seriously injured and on the verge of death. They were rescued by mysterious creatures who fought to the death.
If it hadn't been for the desperate resistance of the eight transcendent beings, the entire defense line would have been wiped out.
But even so, the situation continues to worsen.
More than two hundred years have passed, and three lines of defense in Wugui Space and Sea have completely collapsed.
All living beings in the world suffered heavy losses, and there were not even one survivor left.
Rao is the only remaining transcendent being - Chaos Dragon Lord, Ning Wu Jiu, Supreme Sword Emperor, Galaxy Sword Ancestor, Sky Swallowing Bull Lord, Dung Sea Maggot Emperor, Supreme Horse King, White Tiger Empress. These transcendent beings are all stained with blood, and each of them has varying degrees of injuries.
The Chaos Dragon Lord's dragon robe was shattered, and there was a claw mark on his chest that was as deep as the bone. The black ominous power was constantly eroding the wound, and it could only be suppressed with dragon energy.
Ning Wujiu's plain white robe was stained with blood, and his left arm hung unnaturally. It was obvious that his bones had been broken.
The Taishang Sword Emperor's sword was covered with cracks, and golden blood kept flowing out of the corners of his mouth.
The White Tiger Empress' armor was mostly broken into pieces, her hair was messy, and her cold face looked a little tired.
The situation is infinitely tilted towards the side of the ominous ethnic group...
Everyone knows that if this continues, defeat is only a matter of time.
In another hundred years at most, the ominous army will be able to completely conquer the sea of ​​time and space, enter the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths, and completely drag all the heavens and worlds into the abyss of darkness.
The feeling of despair hangs over the heart of every living being like a dark cloud.
Many people are ready to fight to the death.
title_en: Chapter 932: That back view Chapter 931: The ominous ethnic group’s heaven-defying heritage
